name: @absolutejs/meeting-recall
description: Recall.ai source adapter for @absolutejs/meeting — Recall joins a Google Meet / Zoom / Teams call as a bot and streams per-participant audio into the meeting core for live transcription + analysis
author: Alex Kahn

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun --external @absolutejs/voice --external @absolutejs/meeting && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --project tsconfig.json
scripts.release: bun run format && bun run build && bun publish
